purpose: Define the canonical network-observation schema required for offline network/blockchain correlation.

validation_rules.asn: Non-negative numeric ASN, optionally prefixed with AS.

dataset_constraint: The Elliptic++ source used by this project does not contain IP, port, ASN, country, or network-layer timestamps. This schema therefore defines an ingestion interface and does not represent observed network measurements.
provenance_requirement: Every network observation should identify its observation_source so real, synthetic, replayed, or externally supplied data are distinguishable.
